invariants.rationale: instantTime is used to identify the timeline instant for the delete; it should typically be non-null.
The method expects a list of HoodieKey objects to delete, which must be provided.
A delete operation should be invoked with non-empty keys list to have an effect.
The engine context is required for execution, so it should not be null at method entry.
The list of keys should not contain null entries for the delete operation to be meaningful.
